query: Please implement a VS score counter website for scoring and voice broadcasting. The website should have functionalities for scoring, voice broadcasting, and user interaction. Users should be able to input scores, perform scoring, and conduct voice broadcasting. The website should also be able to adapt to different resolutions and device compatibility. Choose white smoke for global background and rosy brown for all components.
